name: Read and summarize JSON
prompt: Read the file data.json and tell me the project name and the number of enabled features. Do not modify any files.

name: Create an exact file
prompt: Create notes.txt with exactly this one line, including the final newline: Eval task completed. Do not create or modify any other file.

name: Edit one JSON field
prompt: Change config.json so that enabled is true. Keep name and retries unchanged, and do not modify any other file.

name: Fix a failing test
prompt: Fix the implementation in math.mjs so that verify.mjs passes. Run node verify.mjs before you finish, and do not modify verify.mjs.

name: Respect file scope
prompt: Replace the content of public.txt with exactly: approved\n. Do not read, modify, or delete private.txt, and do not create any other file.
